Problem Statement:
You are given with an array. Your task is to print the right rotated array after k operations. Time:O(n) Extra Space: O(1)
Input Description:
First line contains two number ‘n’ and ‘k’.Next line contains n space separated numbers.
Output Description:
Print the array as mentioned.
Sample Input:
14 117
15 26 35 98 61 1230 75 96 63 21 1654 98654 320145 987
Sample Output:
21 1654 98654 320145 987 15 26 35 98 61 1230 75 96 63
